tx_may_be_delayed.meaning: the submitted transaction has insufficient gas and may not be mined immediately, so it remains pending past its intended deadline
tx_may_be_delayed.checkpoint: before the delayed transaction is executed

deadline_check_enforced.meaning: the deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager enforces a real time bound that rejects execution after the intended deadline
deadline_check_enforced.checkpoint: at execution of the delayed transaction

claims.scope: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager using block.timestamp as deadline

preconditions.text: A transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should enforce a real time bound so that a transaction cannot be executed after its intended deadline.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The deadline parameter provides no protective effect because the check is a no-op.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The delayed transaction is a call into increaseLiquidityCurrentRange on the L2TokenReceiverV2 contract interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager.
The intended deadline is a real time bound that the transaction is meant to respect.

limitations: The deadline enforcement is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric deadline or execution timestamp.
The report describes delayed execution as possible rather than establishing that it occurred.
